mapper.select: SELECT assignment.id AS assignment_id, assignment.task_id, assignment.student_id, assignment.source_type, assignment.source_organization_id, task.creator_user_id, assignment.current_status, assignment.version_no, assignment.scheduled_date, assignment.last_defer_type, assignment.defer_count FROM learn_task_assignment assignment JOIN learn_task task ON task.id = assignment.task_id WHERE assignment.id = #{assignmentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql:
FROM learn_task_assignment assignment JOIN learn_task task ON task.id = assignment.task_id JOIN edu_student student ON student.id = assignment.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_organization source_organization ON source_organization.id = assignment.source_organization_id WHERE (assignment.current_status = 'NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT' OR (assignment.current_status = 'PENDING_CLAIM' AND assignment.last_defer_type = 'AUTO')) AND ( 1 = 0
OR (assignment.source_type = 'FAMILY' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_parent_student relation WHERE relation.parent_user_id = #{query.currentUserId} AND relation.student_id = assignment.student_id AND relation.status = 'ACTIVE' AND relation.relation_role = 'PRIMARY_GUARDIAN' AND relation.primary_scope_key = 'PRIMARY' ))
OR (assignment.source_type = 'TEACHER' AND task.creator_user_id = #{query.currentUserId})
OR (assignment.source_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_organization task_source_organization JOIN sys_organization administrator_root ON task_source_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(administrator_root.organization_path, '%') JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.organization_id = administrator_root.id WHERE task_source_organization.id = assignment.source_organization_id AND organization_admin.user_id = #{query.currentUserId} ))
)
mapper.select:
SELECT assignment.id AS assignment_id, task.title, student.id AS student_id, student.student_name, assignment.source_type, source_organization.organization_name AS source_organization_name, assignment.scheduled_date, assignment.current_status, assignment.last_defer_type, assignment.overnight_migrated
ORDER BY assignment.scheduled_date, assignment.id LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}
